title: Post game
note: The black outro of about 3 s: the End phase fades to black (0.4 s; a cut under reduced motion), plays one sound for both outcomes, routes no voice (#213) and returns everyone to the lobby after 3 s (#212). Nobody hears anybody and no text says so. Roles are not revealed. No input.

states.label: Перемога
states.note: An Engineer's view: every task done in time.

states.label: Поразка
states.note: An Engineer's view: the time ran out.

nodes.name: Night
nodes.note: P2, opaque: the style's darkest stands for the decided black. It fades in over 0.4 s when the End phase starts (a cut under reduced motion).

nodes.name: V

children.name: Winner
children.note: The winning team on the title plate (raised on ToyBaseTitle): end.won_engineers or end.won_dissidents.

children.name: Result
children.note: Whether the own team won and why.

children.name: Team
children.note: Whether the own team won: end.your_team_won or end.your_team_lost.

children.name: Reason
children.note: Why the round ended, from the host's reason id (#208): end.reason.all_tasks with the round's time (m:ss) or end.reason.time_up. An unknown reason hides the line.

children.name: Gap
children.note: With the column's two 32 px gaps, 72 px between the reason and the countdown.

children.name: Back
children.note: Counts 3, 2, 1 once a second; at 0 everyone is back in the lobby (#212).

nodes.note: The 32 px gaps clear the title plate's expand margins (4 px above it, the base 14 px below).
